messages:
incident-bot: [PAGER] HIGH error-rate detected for tenant orbit-acct-42 in orbit-vpc (dedicated pool: orbit-pool-3). 5xx rate > 8% over 3m, latency spiking. Paging oncall. severity: high
ryan-oncall: on it. joining bridge now. any immediate customer reports? @julie-cs can you check CSM slack?
julie-cs: not yet, I pinged their CSM. they said some API calls are timing out but waiting on logs.
ali-sre: seeing GPU OOMs and backend rpc timeouts on nodes g04-*-3 in orbit-pool-3. KV cache miss rate jumped ~12x. likely noisy tenant or model mismatch.
maya-runtime: timeline guess — heavy replays from tenant + large context sequences triggered GC of KV cache and forced eviction, causing regen load. Can we isolate the tenant and fallback routing?
ryan-oncall: proposing immediate isolation + routed duplicates to fallback pool in us-west-2. Command to quiesce: `rbctl tenant quarantine orbit-acct-42 --pool orbit-pool-3 --reason "elevated-5xx"`
k|kevin-eng: FYI that command will trigger autoscale fallback. also prepare config to pin model variant to gpt-small-quant for that tenant: `rbctl tenant set-model orbit-acct-42 --model gpt-small-quant`
ali-sre: running quarantine now, will drain new connections from orbit-pool-3 and route to fallback-pool-a.
incident-bot: action taken: tenant orbit-acct-42 quarantined at 5987654405 by ali-sre. traffic rerouted to fallback-pool-a (us-west-2).
ryan-oncall: monitoring latency/5xx now. Ali, can you confirm KV cache warming policy for fallback?
ali-sre: warming policy set to aggressive for quarantined tenants. pre-warming cold keys for orbit-acct-42. watchlist: kv_miss_ratio, p99_latency, gpu_util.
maya-runtime: also enabling strict batching limit and reducing max_seq to 1024 for this tenant to reduce memory pressure. Applying now.
kevin-eng: applied model pin + seq limit. expected reduction in OOMs.
julie-cs: CSM on call to Orbit reports degraded API for ~18 minutes; they saw about ~30% failed requests in that window. asking for mitigation ETA and any credits.
helen-security: any data-plane exposure risk from this isolation? looks like no. just performance.
maya-runtime: confirmed no data exfil. isolation is config-only.
ryan-oncall: p99 latency dropped from 2.8s to 1.1s after reroute. 5xx rate from 8.4% -> 1.2% in 7m. continue to monitor for 30m then de-escalate.
julie-cs: I'll prepare an initial customer note: short summary + what we did + ETA for RCA. will propose goodwill credit option.
kevin-eng: suggest we offer a prorated credit for the degraded window and one-time engineering support for tuning. will draft numbers after we have full token counts.
ali-sre: capturing artifacts: `kubectl logs --since=1h -l pool=orbit-pool-3 > /artifacts/orbit-pool3-logs.txt` and `rb-metrics export --tenant orbit-acct-42 --range 1h > /artifacts/orbit-tenant-metrics.json`
ryan-oncall: good. I'm going to page infra team to check if any autoscaling thresholds were misconfigured for this pool before restoring.
incident-bot: [UPDATE] mitigation complete; service stabilized at 5987655900.
julie-cs: Orbit CSM relayed: they accepted mitigation but want exec summary and an assurance on SLA handling. preparing comms for their VP of Ops.
maya-runtime: for RCA, initial notes: root cause = tenant started backfill with large seq-length prompts + concurrent regen loops; cache eviction + model variant memory footprint caused cascading OOMs on orbit-pool-3. Contributing factors: lack of per-tenant model caps, autoscale thresholds tuned for steady-state, not spikes, and incomplete KV prewarming for cold failovers.
helen-security: add note: no anonymity/data exposure. compliance ok.
ali-sre: timeline to produce RCA draft ~24-36h. I'll include timeline of events, metrics, and recommended fixes: per-tenant model caps, stronger prewarmed replicas, and a failover cooldown to prevent immediate reinjection to same pool.
julie-cs: I'll draft customer comm. Ryan, can you add a one-paragraph exec note that includes recommended credits (pro-rated for 18m degraded window + 10% goodwill)?
ryan-oncall: yes. Draft exec blurb: "We experienced elevated error rates for tenant orbit-acct-42 due to a large workload spike that exceeded memory assumptions for the dedicated pool. We isolated the tenant and redirected traffic, restoring service within ~10 minutes of mitigation. We're preparing a full RCA and propose a prorated credit for the degraded window plus a 10% one-time credit as goodwill."
kevin-eng: thumbs up. I'll create an internal runbook update ticket: `ENG-OPS #4872` to add per-tenant caps and model pinning automation.
julie-cs: sending initial customer message now (internal copy): "We've mitigated the issue and restored service. We will follow up with RCA and proposed credit within 36 hours. Sorry for the disruption." sending -> :rocket:
ryan-oncall: thanks. I'll stay on watch for 2 hours then hand back to regular oncall.
ali-sre: leaving bridge, moving to RCA work.
incident-bot: [RESOLVED] incident for orbit-acct-42 marked resolved at 5987657890 by ryan-oncall.
julie-cs: post-incident tasks: 1) RCA draft (ali) 2) exec note + credit calc (ryan + kevin) 3) customer comm final (julie) 4) runbook changes (kevin). tagging assignees.
maya-runtime: will follow up on model-tuning deliverable and help test pinning automation in staging.
kevin-eng: created ENG-OPS ticket and linked artifacts.
julie-cs: thanks everyone. I'll update Orbit's CSM and schedule an exec sync if they request one. :white_check_mark:
